en: Alola! You must be the trial-goer Mallow keeps messaging me about. I'm Olivia, kahuna of Akala.
Before my grand trial, go up to the Ruins of Life past Memorial Hill. Your friend Lillie is waiting there.
Welcome to Konikoni! Mind the jewelry. It's all for sale.
The Ruins of Life are past Memorial Hill, east of Route 9. Lillie's waiting, so off you go!
You've been to the guardian's shrine. Then you're ready. I'm Akala's kahuna, and I don't do anything halfway!
Well! That was a gem of a battle. Akala's stamp is yours.
And take Machamp along. With it in your Ride Pager, heavy boulders won't stand in your way.
{player} registered Machamp in the Ride Pager! Machamp can shove heavy boulders.
Lillie and Hau went down to the Hano Grand Resort. Go south from Royal Avenue and say hello.
Two stamps down, two to go! The other kahunas won't go easy on you either.
